panels.title: Why Snowflake?
panels.body:
- 64-bit fits in a signed long
- Time-sortable: range queries on primary keys are efficient
- No single point of failure (unlike DB auto-increment)
- 4 million IDs/sec per worker node throughput

panels.title: Clock Drift Problem
panels.body:
If the system clock drifts backwards (NTP adjustment),
the worker refuses to generate IDs until the
clock catches up to the last timestamp used.

Prevents ID collisions within a millisecond.
